note: RV park NW of Altoona, 3 miles off I-35 exit 89, on concrete pads. Tent camping isn't allowed. Sites sit around a small fishing pond with a fountain, not lakefront. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45 (effective 10/01/2026), 50 amp full hookups, showers, laundry. Count 142->143, booking by phone, year-round, wifi added; camp store cleared (not listed). Pond under an acre, no lead.
flags: GATE FACTS: posted $45 a night (operator, effective 10/01/2026), under $50. GS: not a Good Sam Park (stored false stands). Gateway: none within 40 km (Kansas City 300 km). Presence: working site, phone. RATINGS: Google 4.6 (534 reviews); RV Life 4.5 stars, price tier 2. Passes.

LONG-STAY, report for AWH; I read it as long-stay leaning but selling nights, not a drop on the tests: rules PDF, section 10: 'Because we primarily cater to long-term campers who are in the area for work, we require quiet time in the park from 8pm to 6am'; reservations page: 'a secluded park with a quiet atmosphere catering to longer term campers'; home page 'Extended Stays WELCOME'; rules speak of 'Lessees', a 3-day notice to cure and eviction. Against that, the nightly rate is posted first and all five RV Life reviews read are 2026 stays at $45 a night ('stayed 10/2026 ... We had a couple of great days'). Five tests: 1 sells nights yes; 2 nightly rate posted yes; 3 no homes or lots for sale seen; 4 share of nightly sites not stated, can't be measured from imagery; 5 workforce-leaning by its own words. Rating is 4.6, so the under-4 automatic drop doesn't apply.

POLICY, for EKKO's future: rules say 'If your RV / Camper is more than 5 years old you will be required to provide proof of condition of the RV / camper thru pictures before you are allowed a site', and a photo of a valid driver's license is 'required prior to receiving your site'. EKKO (2023) reaches the 5-year line in 2028, and it's a photo requirement, not an age ban. Also a review of 7/2026 (rating 4): 'It does seem like there are two campgrounds in one. There is a nice side and an area that looks shabby, unkept, and unsafe'; 10/2026: 'Only, book into the new section'. So the newer section is what to ask for.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Operator: 'The pond is available for using your fishing equipment'; 'Decorative fountain and small stream'. Reviewer calls it a 'Beautiful lake', but imagery shows a pond about 70 x 45 m, under an acre: a pond by AWH's rule, no pond-view. Pin 41.6776,-93.5195 sits at the south parking-lot block, about 170 m from the park's centre; within tolerance. Stored note's 'Pool' and 'adjacent paved bike/walk trail' are on no operator page read, so dropped from the note (no --AWH text).
APPLY: phone 515-967-5474 matches; second line 515-240-7593 on the operator's page.
